title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement (33 Grade).

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the manufacture and requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement. Prescribes chemical requirements (magnesia, sulphuric anhydride, loss on ignition) and physical requirements including fineness, setting time, soundness, and compressive strength (not less than 23 MPa at 3 days, 33 MPa at 7 days, and 43 MPa at 28 days).

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the manufacture and requirements of 53 grade ordinary Portland cement. Prescribes compressive strength not less than 27 MPa at 3 days, 37 MPa at 7 days, and 53 MPa at 28 days.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the requirements of high strength deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete. Covers grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600. Specifies tensile properties, bend and rebend tests, chemical composition, and dimensions.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the requirements for aggregates, crushed or uncrushed, derived from natural sources, for use in the production of concrete for normal structural purposes including mass concrete. Covers grading, physical properties, deleterious materials, and test methods.

title: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement
scope_summary: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement including fineness, consistency, setting time, soundness, and compressive strength.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete
scope_summary: Methods of test for aggregates for concrete, covering particle size, shape, specific gravity, water absorption, and mechanical properties.
